hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; case "$cmd" in *"git push"*|*"gh workflow run"*|*"gh secret set"*|*"gh secret remove"*|*"gh secret delete"*) echo "[Hook] Reminder: this touches production (push to main auto-deploys via .github/workflows/deploy.yml, or triggers/rotates a deploy secret) - confirm with the user first if not already agreed. See CLAUDE.md." >&2;; esac; }; true

PreToolUse.description: Non-blocking reminder before commands that touch the o2switch deploy pipeline

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; case "$cmd" in *make*) : ;; *"docker compose"*|*"docker-compose"*|*"composer "*|*"npm "*) echo "[Hook] Reminder: this repo prefers make targets over raw docker/composer/npm (see README Commands table / 'make help')." >&2;; esac; }; true

PreToolUse.description: Non-blocking reminder to prefer make targets over raw docker/composer/npm

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.php) case "$f" in */web/wp/*|*/vendor/*|*/web/app/plugins/*|*/web/app/themes/twentytwentyfive/*) exit 0;; esac; rel="${f#$PWD/}"; docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory . exec -T php vendor/bin/pint "$rel";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
